## Why it matters internationally

The Ruan group's barium-sulfate radiative-cooling paints — 98.1% solar
reflectance with strong sky-window emission — are the most visible
demonstration that engineered emissivity scales from metasurfaces to
paint cans, with peer-reviewed field tests behind the headlines.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** solar reflectance · sky-window emissivity (engineered paints)
- **Spectral range:** solar spectrum + 8–13 µm sky window
- **Temperature:** field demonstrations under full sun
- **Methodology:** BaSO4-based radiative cooling paints with 98.1% solar reflectance and high sky-window emissivity (the 'whitest paint'); full-scale field cooling tests.

**Application domains:** radiative cooling paints · building energy.
